message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t tell you the exact temperature in Riga right now.  
You can quickly check the current temperature by:

1. Visiting a weather website such as [weather.com](https://weather.com) or [accuweather.com](https://www.accuweather.com) and searching for “Riga, Latvia.”
2. Using a weather app on your phone (e.g., Weather, AccuWeather, or the built‑in weather app).
3. Asking a voice assistant (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) with the query “What’s the temperature in Riga?”

If you’d like, I can help you set up a simple script that pulls the current temperature from a public API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap). Just let me know!

We can approximate or say we can't fetch real-time data. We can suggest using a weather API or website. We can also use a function? There's no function for weather. So we should respond that we cannot fetch real-time data. Provide guidance.
